Not applicable for this qualitative analysis.

Based on the given equilibrium constants, MO is more stable then MO2.

questions.question: With increase in temperature, equilibrium constant of reaction :-

questions.explanation:
The effect of temperature on the equilibrium constant depends on whether the reaction is endothermic or exothermic:
- For an endothermic reaction (ΔH > 0): An increase in temperature favors the forward reaction (product formation), so the equilibrium constant (K) increases.
- For an exothermic reaction (ΔH < 0): An increase in temperature favors the reverse reaction (reactant formation), so the equilibrium constant (K) decreases.
